# Welcome

Hi, I'm Trevor Gratz, a senior data scientist specializing in complex analytical challenges. I apply causal inference, machine learning, and rigorous evaluation to drive strategic decisions and enhance operational efficiency.

With over a decade of experience leading projects from ideation to implementation, I transform complex, fragmented data into actionable insights for executive leaders, program managers, and technical teams. My work is grounded in a commitment to equity, ensuring that data-driven decisions foster fair and just outcomes. I have a proven track record of building novel datasets, developing state-of-the-art predictive models, and architecting the data systems necessary to measure and evaluate program impacts. I am a co-author on over ten peer-reviewed [publications](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=X7r0bxsAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao) cited by more than 575 journal articles.

## Featured Projects

Here are a few highlighted projects that demonstrate my capabilities:

#### Building scalable data infrastructure for behavioral health program evaluation


Spearheaded the complete redesign of Pierce County's behavioral health data system, expanding from 7 to 27 participating providers. Established client-level tracking for over 90,000 services across 16,000 clients and counting, while developing comprehensive data collection protocols and quality assurance systems to support outcome evaluations.

👉 [View Project ›](Modernize_BH.qmd)

#### Diagnosing Chagas disease with deep convolutional neural networks

Created a hybrid convolutional neural network plus transformer model to diagnose Chagas disease from electrocardiogram data and achieved state-of-the-art performance.   
👉 [View Project ›](Chagas.qmd)

---

####  Prioritization and equitable allocation of housing interventions for homeless households

Built upon existing literature to develop a weighted optimization algorithm that balances exiting the greatest number of households from homelessness while minimizing inequitable housing resource allocation.

👉 [View Project ›](Prioritization.qmd)

---

####  Mobile medication-assisted therapy for substance use disorder treatment site location
 
Worked with program managers to create an interactive application allowing for the exploration of site locations based on historical overdose call data. 

👉 [View Project ›](RCT.qmd)
